# Expression Variation Reproducibility: YPD.1 vs YPD.2

## Overview
Analyzing whether strain-level gene expression variation is reproducible across two replicate single-cell experiments (YPD.1 and YPD.2). We examine: (1) global expression rankings, (2) per-gene correlation across strains, (3) what predicts reproducibility, and (4) whether shared eQTLs show high expression reproducibility.

```{r setup-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(patchwork)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
count <- dplyr::count 

# Define output directory
OUTPUT_DIR <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle/Figure.3/Fig.3-supplementary/reproducibility_of_eQTL_mapping_between_conditions/results"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
cat("Output directory:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n\n")
```

## Part 1: Global Gene Expression Ranking

**Question**: Do highly expressed genes in YPD.1 rank similarly in YPD.2?

```{r global-ranking}
# Find shared genes and strains
shared_strains_raw <- intersect(colnames(YPD1_pseudobulk), colnames(YPD2_pseudobulk))
shared_genes_raw   <- intersect(rownames(YPD1_pseudobulk), rownames(YPD2_pseudobulk))

cat("Global ranking analysis:\n")
cat("  Shared strains:", length(shared_strains_raw), "\n")
cat("  Shared genes:  ", length(shared_genes_raw), "\n\n")

# Subset and calculate mean expression
YPD1_sub_raw <- YPD1_pseudobulk[shared_genes_raw, shared_strains_raw]
YPD2_sub_raw <- YPD2_pseudobulk[shared_genes_raw, shared_strains_raw]

YPD1_mean <- rowMeans(YPD1_sub_raw)
YPD2_mean <- rowMeans(YPD2_sub_raw)

spearman_r <- cor(YPD1_mean, YPD2_mean, method = "spearman")
cat("Spearman r (global ranking):", round(spearman_r, 3), "\n\n")

# Plot ranked expression
comparison_df_ranked <- data.frame(
  YPD1_rank = rank(YPD1_mean),
  YPD2_rank = rank(YPD2_mean),
  gene = shared_genes_raw
)

p_ranking <- ggplot(comparison_df_ranked, aes(x = YPD1_rank, y = YPD2_rank)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.3, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = paste0("Spearman r = ", round(spearman_r, 3)),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Global gene expression rank: YPD.1 vs YPD.2",
    x = "YPD.1 pseudobulk mean (rank)",
    y = "YPD.2 pseudobulk mean (rank)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

print(p_ranking)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Fig1_global_ranking_YPD1_vs_YPD2.tiff"),
       p_ranking, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
cat("✓ Saved: Fig1_global_ranking_YPD1_vs_YPD2.tiff\n\n")
```

## Part 2: Per-Gene Correlation After DESeq2 Normalization

**Question**: After normalization, do strain patterns for each gene agree between replicates?

```{r deseq2-normalization}
cat("DESeq2 normalization:\n")

# Normalize YPD.1
dds_YPD1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(YPD1_pseudobulk)),
  colData = data.frame(row.names = colnames(YPD1_pseudobulk),
                       condition = factor(colnames(YPD1_pseudobulk))),
  design = ~ 1
)
dds_YPD1 <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_YPD1)
YPD1_norm <- as.data.frame(counts(dds_YPD1, normalized = TRUE))
cat("  YPD1 normalized:", nrow(YPD1_norm), "genes ×", ncol(YPD1_norm), "strains\n")

# Normalize YPD.2
dds_YPD2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(YPD2_pseudobulk)),
  colData = data.frame(row.names = colnames(YPD2_pseudobulk),
                       condition = factor(colnames(YPD2_pseudobulk))),
  design = ~ 1
)
dds_YPD2 <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_YPD2)
YPD2_norm <- as.data.frame(counts(dds_YPD2, normalized = TRUE))
cat("  YPD2 normalized:", nrow(YPD2_norm), "genes ×", ncol(YPD2_norm), "strains\n\n")

# Find shared genes and strains for correlation
shared_strains <- intersect(colnames(YPD1_norm), colnames(YPD2_norm))
shared_genes   <- intersect(rownames(YPD1_norm), rownames(YPD2_norm))

cat("  Shared strains:", length(shared_strains), "\n")
cat("  Shared genes:  ", length(shared_genes), "\n\n")

# Subset normalized matrices
YPD1_sub <- YPD1_norm[shared_genes, shared_strains]
YPD2_sub <- YPD2_norm[shared_genes, shared_strains]

# Calculate per-gene Spearman correlation across strains
gene_cor <- sapply(shared_genes, function(gene) {
  cor(as.numeric(YPD1_sub[gene, ]),
      as.numeric(YPD2_sub[gene, ]),
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs")
})

cat("✓ Per-gene correlations calculated\n\n")
```

## Part 3: Categorize Genes by Reproducibility

## Part 3: Categorize Genes by Reproducibility (FIXED)

```{r categorize-genes}
# Create dataframe with categories - r=0.7 counted only in HIGH category
gene_cor_df <- data.frame(
  gene = shared_genes,
  correlation = gene_cor
) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_category = case_when(
      correlation >= 0.7 ~ "high (≥0.7)",
      correlation >= 0.4 & correlation < 0.7 ~ "moderate (0.4–<0.7)",
      correlation < 0.4 ~ "low (<0.4)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Summary statistics
cat("Per-gene Spearman correlation summary:\n")
cat("  High (r ≥ 0.7):        ", sum(gene_cor_df$correlation >= 0.7, na.rm = TRUE), "genes\n")
cat("  Moderate (0.4 ≤ r < 0.7):    ", sum(gene_cor_df$correlation >= 0.4 & gene_cor_df$correlation < 0.7, na.rm = TRUE), "genes\n")
cat("  Low (r < 0.4):         ", sum(gene_cor_df$correlation < 0.4, na.rm = TRUE), "genes\n\n")
```

**Key fix:**
✅ Changed label from `"moderate (0.4–0.7)"` to `"moderate (0.4–<0.7)"` to make clear that 0.7 is NOT included  
✅ Condition remains: `correlation >= 0.4 & correlation < 0.7` (excludes 0.7)  
✅ High category gets: `correlation >= 0.7` (includes 0.7)  
✅ No double-counting at the boundary

## Part 5: Compare High vs Low Reproducibility Genes

**Question**: What distinguishes reproducible genes from non-reproducible genes?

```{r compare-reproducibility-groups}
# Build strain cell metadata
strain_cells <- inner_join(
  Na_va_data_subsetted_YPD1@meta.data %>%
    group_by(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS) %>%
    summarise(n_cells_YPD1 = n(), .groups = "drop"),
  Na_va_data_subsetted_YPD2@meta.data %>%
    group_by(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS) %>%
    summarise(n_cells_YPD2 = n(), .groups = "drop"),
  by = "strain"
) %>%
  mutate(avg_cells = (n_cells_YPD1 + n_cells_YPD2) / 2)

# Calculate detection and expression metrics
n_strains_detected_YPD1 <- rowSums(YPD1_sub > 0)
n_strains_detected_YPD2 <- rowSums(YPD2_sub > 0)
mean_n_detected <- (n_strains_detected_YPD1 + n_strains_detected_YPD2) / 2

avg_cells_per_gene_YPD1 <- sapply(shared_genes, function(g) {
  detected_strains <- colnames(YPD1_sub)[as.numeric(YPD1_sub[g, ]) > 0]
  if (length(detected_strains) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(strain_cells$avg_cells[strain_cells$strain %in% detected_strains], na.rm = TRUE)
})

avg_cells_per_gene_YPD2 <- sapply(shared_genes, function(g) {
  detected_strains <- colnames(YPD2_sub)[as.numeric(YPD2_sub[g, ]) > 0]
  if (length(detected_strains) == 0) return(NA)
  mean(strain_cells$avg_cells[strain_cells$strain %in% detected_strains], na.rm = TRUE)
})

# Build master gene dataframe
master_gene_df <- gene_cor_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(
      gene = shared_genes,
      mean_expr = (rowMeans(YPD1_sub) + rowMeans(YPD2_sub)) / 2
    ),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(
      gene = shared_genes,
      avg_cells_gene = (avg_cells_per_gene_YPD1 + avg_cells_per_gene_YPD2) / 2,
      n_strains_detected = mean_n_detected[shared_genes]
    ),
    by = "gene"
  )

# Split by reproducibility threshold
genes_high_r <- master_gene_df %>% filter(correlation >= 0.4)
genes_low_r <- master_gene_df %>% filter(correlation < 0.4)

cat("Gene groups by reproducibility:\n")
cat("  r ≥ 0.4 (reproducible):    ", nrow(genes_high_r), "genes\n")
cat("  r < 0.4 (low reproducibility): ", nrow(genes_low_r), "genes\n\n")

# Wilcoxon tests
wt_expr     <- wilcox.test(genes_high_r$mean_expr, genes_low_r$mean_expr, alternative = "greater")
wt_cells    <- wilcox.test(genes_high_r$avg_cells_gene, genes_low_r$avg_cells_gene, alternative = "greater")
wt_detected <- wilcox.test(genes_high_r$n_strains_detected, genes_low_r$n_strains_detected, alternative = "greater")

cat("Statistical comparisons (Wilcoxon test):\n")
cat("  Mean expression (high > low):  p =", format(wt_expr$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Avg cell count (high > low):   p =", format(wt_cells$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Strains detected (high > low): p =", format(wt_detected$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n\n")
```

```{r plot-group-comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),

print(pA)

       pA, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

## Part 9: Shared eQTLs Expression Reproducibility

**Question**: Do genes with shared eQTLs show higher expression reproducibility than average?

```{r load-shared-eqtls}
# Load shared eQTLs
shared_eqtls <- read.csv(
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "shared_eQTLs_YPD1_vs_YPD2_ALL_variants.csv")
)

cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("SHARED eQTL SUMMARY\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("Total rows in shared eQTL file:", nrow(shared_eqtls), "\n")
cat("(Note: each association appears once per source, so YPD.1 rows only)\n\n")
cat("Unique genes with shared eQTLs:", n_distinct(shared_eqtls$Pheno), "\n\n")
```

```{r resolve-gene-names}
# Gene name resolution function
resolve_genes <- function(gene_vec, label) {
  
  cat("\n" , strrep("=", 60), "\n", label, "\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
  
  n_assoc <- length(gene_vec)
  gene_vec <- unique(gene_vec)
  cat("Total associations: ", n_assoc, " | Unique genes: ", length(gene_vec), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Step 1: direct match
  matched <- gene_vec[gene_vec %in% gene_cor_df$gene]
  unmatched <- gene_vec[!gene_vec %in% gene_cor_df$gene]
  cat("Direct match:", length(matched), "| Unmatched:", length(unmatched), "\n")
  
  if (length(unmatched) == 0) {
    return(list(resolved = matched, unresolved = character(0), n_assoc = n_assoc))
  }
  
  # Step 2: .A → -A conversion
  dash_converted <- gsub("\\.A$", "-A", unmatched)
  dot_matched <- dash_converted[dash_converted %in% gene_cor_df$gene]
  still_unmatched_orfs <- dash_converted[!dash_converted %in% gene_cor_df$gene]
  cat("After .A → -A:", length(dot_matched), "| Still unmatched:", length(still_unmatched_orfs), "\n")
  
  # Step 3: common name lookup
  if (length(still_unmatched_orfs) > 0) {
    name_map <- tryCatch(
      AnnotationDbi::select(org.Sc.sgd.db, keys = still_unmatched_orfs,
                            columns = c("ORF", "GENENAME"), keytype = "ORF") %>%
        filter(!is.na(GENENAME)),
      error = function(e) data.frame(ORF = character(0), GENENAME = character(0))
    )
    
    common_matched <- c()
    truly_unresolved <- c()
    
    for (orf in still_unmatched_orfs) {
      common <- name_map$GENENAME[name_map$ORF == orf]
      if (length(common) > 0 && common %in% gene_cor_df$gene) {
        common_matched <- c(common_matched, common)
      } else {
        truly_unresolved <- c(truly_unresolved, orf)
      }
    }
    cat("Common name matched:", length(common_matched), "| Unresolved:", length(truly_unresolved), "\n")
  } else {
    common_matched <- c()
    truly_unresolved <- c()
  }
  
  resolved <- c(matched, dot_matched, common_matched)
  cat("✓ Total resolved:", length(resolved), "genes\n")
  
  list(resolved = resolved, unresolved = truly_unresolved, n_assoc = n_assoc)
}

# Resolve for each variant type
snp_genes   <- shared_eqtls$Pheno[shared_eqtls$Variant_Type == "SNPs" & shared_eqtls$Source == "YPD.1"]
cnv_genes   <- shared_eqtls$Pheno[shared_eqtls$Variant_Type == "CNVs" & shared_eqtls$Source == "YPD.1"]
indel_genes <- shared_eqtls$Pheno[shared_eqtls$Variant_Type == "InDels" & shared_eqtls$Source == "YPD.1"]
sv_genes    <- shared_eqtls$Pheno[shared_eqtls$Variant_Type == "SVs" & shared_eqtls$Source == "YPD.1"]
all_genes   <- shared_eqtls$Pheno[shared_eqtls$Source == "YPD.1"]

snp_resolved   <- resolve_genes(snp_genes, "SNP eQTLs")
cnv_resolved   <- resolve_genes(cnv_genes, "CNV eQTLs")
indel_resolved <- resolve_genes(indel_genes, "Indel eQTLs")
sv_resolved    <- resolve_genes(sv_genes, "SV eQTLs")
all_resolved   <- resolve_genes(all_genes, "All eQTLs")

# Look up correlations
lookup_cor <- function(resolved_list, label) {
  gene_cor_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% resolved_list$resolved) %>%
    arrange(desc(correlation)) %>%
    mutate(overlap_set = label, n_associations = resolved_list$n_assoc)
}

overlap_snp   <- lookup_cor(snp_resolved, "Shared SNP eQTLs")
overlap_cnv   <- lookup_cor(cnv_resolved, "Shared CNV eQTLs")
overlap_indel <- lookup_cor(indel_resolved, "Shared Indel eQTLs")
overlap_sv    <- lookup_cor(sv_resolved, "Shared SV eQTLs")
overlap_all   <- lookup_cor(all_resolved, "Shared all eQTLs")

# Print summaries with gene counts
cat("\n", strrep("═", 60), "\n")
cat("EXPRESSION REPRODUCIBILITY OF SHARED eQTL GENES\n")
cat(strrep("═", 60), "\n\n")

for (ol in list(overlap_snp, overlap_cnv, overlap_indel, overlap_sv, overlap_all)) {
  cat("---", ol$overlap_set[1], "---\n")
  cat("Associations:", ol$n_associations[1], " | Unique genes in analysis:", n_distinct(ol$gene), "\n\n")
  ol %>% count(cor_category) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
    print()
  cat("Range:", round(min(ol$correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      "to", round(max(ol$correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n")
}
```

**Key additions:**

✅ **Shows both associations and unique genes** - clarifies why numbers differ  
✅ **"Associations" column** - from the shared eQTL file  
✅ **"Unique genes in analysis"** - actually used in plots  
✅ **Percentages for each correlation category** - easier to read  
✅ **Includes SVs** - was missing before  

Now the output will clearly show something like:

## Part 10: Visualize Expression Reproducibility of Shared eQTLs

```{r plot-eqtl-overlap, fig.width=18, fig.height=6}
# Faceted bar plot - now includes SVs
overlap_combined <- bind_rows(overlap_snp, overlap_cnv, overlap_indel, overlap_sv, overlap_all) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cor_category)) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_set = factor(overlap_set,
                         levels = c("Shared SNP eQTLs", "Shared CNV eQTLs",
                                    "Shared Indel eQTLs", "Shared SV eQTLs", "Shared all eQTLs")),
    cor_category = factor(cor_category,
                          levels = c("high (≥0.7)", "moderate (0.4–0.7)", "low (<0.4)"))
  )

overlap_counts <- overlap_combined %>%
  count(overlap_set, cor_category) %>%
  group_by(overlap_set) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_eqtl_overlap <- ggplot(overlap_counts, aes(x = cor_category, y = n, fill = cor_category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "high (≥0.7)" = "#2166ac",
    "moderate (0.4–0.7)" = "#92c5de",
    "low (<0.4)" = "#d1e5f0"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ overlap_set, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Correlation category", y = "Number of shared eQTL genes") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = c("Shared SNP eQTLs" = "white", "Shared CNV eQTLs" = "white",
               "Shared Indel eQTLs" = "white", "Shared SV eQTLs" = "white",
               "Shared all eQTLs" = "#e8f5e9"),
      color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(14, 18, 12, 14)
  )

print(p_eqtl_overlap)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Fig5_shared_eQTL_reproducibility.tiff"),
       p_eqtl_overlap, width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
cat("✓ Saved: Fig5_shared_eQTL_reproducibility.tiff\n\n")
```
